name: @bossnyumba/owner-os-tabs
description: BossNyumba OwnerOS tab-type registry + intent matcher + scale-aware defaults. Real-estate spawnable tabs (rent, leases, maintenance, tenants, compliance, finance, marketing, etc.). Shared between owner-portal / tenant-portal / admin-portal (renders panels) and services/api-gateway (validates spawn_tabs payloads emitted by the brain). Ported from Borjie's @borjie/owner-os-tabs.
